$comment: Every user-facing feature and where it lives in each app. A feature only one platform can have says why. freestash/tests/test_parity.py fails if a listed file is missing, a one-sided feature has no reason, or the two apps' navigation drifts apart. Add a row in the same pull request as the feature.

features.name: Sign in, create account, reset password
Federated search: lens, source aperture, spectrum, filters
The source aperture ring (signature element)
Result categories: ids, labels, order, query words (one source, shared/categories.json)
Results grouped by category: 8 per section, Show all (n), jump bar with counts
Query words pick categories, shown as removable chips (Read as)

Packs: one result, many files (Iconify sets, Freesound packs, Internet Archive bundles, GitHub game-asset repos, the admin's curated packs). Card badge, Packs switch, pack words, packs lead each section, detail rows Pack / Formats / Licenses inside
Game assets preset: sprites, 3D, textures, audio, icons and fonts, with packs (one source, shared/categories.json)
Result card: image, title, source · year, verdict, license
Detail: clearance by use, credit line, take it, files
Collections (synced)
Downloads with .license.json provenance
License ledger + ATTRIBUTION.md / credits / CSV export
License check
Sources and their status for this account
Settings: account, API keys with where-to-get help, search defaults, appearance (synced)
Where to get each key (one catalog)
Aperture colours, both themes, four accents (one source)
Site administration: site keys, limits and sources, curated packs, shared-quota meter, users, audit log
features.why: An operator console the owner runs from the website (decision 0003); the desktop is a member client. Members on both apps see which keys the site covers in Settings → API keys.

features.name: Run the Python engine on this computer
features.why: A browser can't start processes; the website always uses the hosted engine.

features.name: Parallel download queue: folders, resume, SHA-256, clipboard watch, drag-out
features.why: Browsers save one file at a time to their own folder and can't hash cross-origin files; the web Downloads page lists the same files and saves each .license.json.
